pruning: Nothing of Zstandard is vendored: the library is compat.zstd 1.5.7's, from the same tarball, and the macro of include/mwrap/zstd/macros.hpp is upstream's definition, written out by tools/generate.py. Its README and both licenses are retained here. The conformance run builds four of the release's examples against compat.zstd, from the tarball downloaded at test time.
